notes.title: Development Being Suspended
notes.content:
[h2]As of 1/16/2025 This game’s development has been suspended indefinitely[/h2]

[h1]The Good News[/h1]
[b]INFEST[/b]STATION is not leaving Steam or ceasing to function. [i][b]It will remain in your library and it will still be fully playable[/b][/i], both solo and with other players. We utilized peer-to-peer architecture for our multiplayer that does not rely on external services to work (the player who creates the crew lobby is the host of their own server).
 
[h1]The Bad News[/h1]
After 11 content, gameplay improvement, and performance improvement updates, we have exhausted our financial runway and sales are insufficient to support the cost of operation for the studio, so the game’s development must be suspended indefinitely.

It has been an exciting but difficult journey full of many surprises (good and bad) and challenges leading us to this point. Although we are saddened that [b]INFEST[/b]STATION was never able to grow into the game it was meant to be, I am extremely proud of what we were able to accomplish with it.

We are eternally grateful to everyone who has supported Atom Switch and INFESTSTATION, which will remain available in Early Access (with a heavily reduced price to reflect the situation), in the event that it can one day be revived and completed.
 
[h2]More information can be found in [url=https://infeststation.com/2025/01/16/see-you-space-cowboy/]the Dev Blog here[/url].[/h2]
 
Until then, we will be pursuing new projects to keep the studio afloat. Be sure to follow the link to our community Discord on the side panel to stay up to date on all future Atom Switch news.
 
-Dan @ Atom Switch.

notes.title: Update 12: Seasonal Content Removed
notes.content:
[h1]Update 12[/h1]
Nov 5, 2024

Halloween Seasonal Content has ended, so the two Halloween themed missions have been removed from the game. There are also a few minor bug fixes and tweaks, as well as some rebalanced threat spawn sets for each mission type, a fix to add sound and visual effects to the destruction of scrap barricades, and some balancing to make eggs less annoying when spawning in doorways.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scrap barricades now have sound and visual effects when destroyed
[*] Non-Halloween missions have had their threat types rebalanced for a bit better diversity across missions and variety within them
[*] Eggs are now much less likely to spawn in doorways (and when they do, they will spawn in fewer numbers) and instead are now more likely to spawn as random clutches of eggs in missions with appropriate/associated threat types
[/list]
[h2]Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed a decal set for security doors to no longer appear metallic
[/list]

notes.title: Update 11: Healing Stations
notes.content:
[h1]Update 11: Healing Stations[/h1]
[i]Oct 18, 2024[/i]

[b]Health Stations have been added to the game![/b]

This was one of the most requested features beside the end-of-mission summary screen (which came online in Update 8) and I’m excited to say it has finally made it into the game. Be on the lookout for functional [b]Decontamination Stations[/b] that can show up in the game in place of the big explode-y ones (you’ll know them by their friendly green screen and lack of horrible flying sparks).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739264/744bc86fa0bd49615470a85d9b446f36250cc3aa.jpg[/img]

It will drain 100 Data collection points from your collection pool each time you use it, but it will also fully restore your health!

There have also been a few other fixes and improvements added as well, check out the notes below for the full changelist:

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Decontamination Stations that can heal injured players for a cost of 100 data
[*] Jack-o-Lanterns are destructible and net some extra Data collection when destroyed
[*] Added additional minor threat variant to missions featuring The Molted insectoid creatures
[*] Added a screen shake effect to exploding objects to make their explosions more noticable and have more impact
[*] ‘Zoomed out’ the mini map that loads up on Hazard Cleaner Console screens to make them more useful to players
[/list]
[h2]Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved Decontamination Station display screen that better fits it’s small size
[*] New VFX and SFX for Decontamination Station’s healing function
[*] Fixed destructible Jack-o-Lanterns to not have their inner glowing core linger after being destroyed
[*] Added new “Operational” screen material for Decontamination Station to help differentiate it from the broken ones that will explode on a proximity trigger
[*] Added new “please wait” screen material for Decontamination Station to indicate when it is ready to be used again
[/list]
[h2]Stability & General Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Low Graphics Settings improvements: I finally tracked down where the extremely Turok-esq ultra fog was coming from on low graphics settings, and have improved the settings to be less foggy and closer to the look of the higher graphics settings.
[*] Added some missing hit reactions to a few threats that lacked them
[/list]

notes.title: Update 10: HALLOWEEN
notes.content:
[i]Oct 1, 2024[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739264/a5486bf5b451c325ed643474b04e40c1c60af1cd.jpg[/img]
Happy October! It’s finally spooky season and we’ve got an update specially built for Horror’s favorite holiday.

The primary feature of this update are the two new Halloween themed missions that will only be available for the month of October. These missions have customized room and hallway decorations, lighting, and artwork and two separate sets of Halloween themed threats!

There are also some regular-type updates included as well, including more quality of life and stability improvements, as well as gameplay improvements and bug fixes. Check the notes below for the full details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739264/eb2c824672528627d0a1bb8a1f99c8d4bdbafa16.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] 2 Special Halloween themed missions have been added with custom decorated rooms and custom threats!
[*] Reduced headshot damage multiplier for Doppleganger threats to make them less likely to be 1-shot kills
[*] Increased the amount of threats that can spawn in throughout a level, and particularly increased the amount that can spawn in after retrieving the crimson drive core for a more intense gameplay experience
[*] Improved threat AI to be less distracted by weapon fire and substantially less likely to be have their movement halted when hit by it
[*] Added hit reactions and hit reaction vfx for more satisfying and clear results when hitting threats with weapons
[*] Added the name of the mission that was selected/played to mission results screen
[/list]

[h2]Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added additional post processing/visual effects around the crimson drive
[*] Halloween themed room variants added to halloween missions
[*] Halloween themed hallway variants added to halloween missions
[*] New artwork added for halloween themed threats
[*] Added customized screen displays to the hazardous wall screen traps
[*] More improvements to 1st person helmet interior art
[*] New flashlight styling for a less 90’s mag-lite looking light shape
[/list]

[h2]Stability & General Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Doors have been adjusted to be less likely to open too far and occasionally clip through walls
[*] Fixed sounds that were not triggering properly on a number of threats
[*] Added new sound fx for zombies
[*] Fixed hit reactions for almost all threats that were not triggering
[*] Fixed bug where mines would not be destroyed for clients
[*] Fixed mine audio to replicate properly for both clients and hosts
[*] Fixed flashlight pointing at strange / unwanted angles for some tools
[*] Fixed despawn/death fx for threats to dissolve nicely instead of randomly poofing out of existence 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 9: September 18th
notes.content:
[h1]Update 9[/h1]
Sep 18, 2024

With update 9, we have refactored the procedural level generator's room selection and prioritization for each of the missions, with the biggest impact coming on missions that feature a "branching" layout design, taking much better advantage of the various large and small POI rooms for a more interesting layout and more active rooms.

The HUD also got some love, with the look getting pushed further towards a projected / AR / hologram style effect, with matching updates to the helmet interior that surrounds it.

Some of the experimental missions also got updates to better spawn threats and spawn them with a bit more diversity in which types it chooses and when. Additionally, player icons will now show each player's proper facing direction on the Map Tool screen, not just the player holding the map! It's a small fix, but a big quality of life boost for helping other players navigate using the map.

Check out the list below for the full set of change notes!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] New distraction device sound fx that is less noisy and annoying
[*] Heavily refactored procedural map spawn sets to add more variation and more appearance of large and small POI rooms, especially on missions with a “branching” layout type
[*] Threats are now much less likely to accidentally kill themselves on a mine when no players are around. For now this means they’re a bit TOO good at avoiding them, but mines are also great when intentionally triggered with a laser shot while we work on finding a middle ground 🙂
[*] New threat type added to M01-EX
[*] Threat spawns set up better for missions that spawn zombies/blobs
[/list]

[h2]Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworking HUD stylization for a better, more cohesive look
[*] Updates to helmet interior mesh/textures to better align with the updated HUD
[/list]

[h2]Stability & General Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where mines could be thrown and stick to nothing, floating in mid air
[*] Fixed and improved red ‘taking damage’ screen flash to not be warped by the HUD projection and to have a softer, more fade-in-from-the-edges look
[*] Fixed an alignment issue that would occasionally happen with mission update text
[*] Fixed Map Tool readout to properly display each player’s facing direction
[*] Fixed the missing collision on the new carryable cryo tanks
[/list]

notes.title: Update 8: Sept 11, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Update 8[/h1]
Sep 11, 2024

This update brings a mix of gameplay, quality of life, and art improvements. The most noticeable change is that there is now a "Mission Results" screen that is displayed after exiting a mission and before returning to the Lobby. This is an early step toward a more robust post-game for players, displaying which players lived or died, how much data was collected, and whether or not they completed the primary objective of getting the Crimson Core to the POD.

NERVe - the visual representation of player health (and eventually a more complex representation of player stress/sanity) was also improved to more clearly and actively reflect how close a player is to death.

Check the notes below for all the changes and improvements!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Health value now correctly controls amplitude of NERVe meter readout and generally improved the readability of the player’s health value on the NERVe display
[*] Added an experimental variation on the first mission that introduces two new threat variants
[*] Made it more clear when players have completed a mission in the mission status HUD element
[*] Added a carryable version of the explosive cryo crate that can be moved around like the explosive barrel
[*] Reduced the blast radius and damage amount for cryo crate hazards
[*] Added a bit of camera shake when players take damage
[*] An “end of mission summary” screen is now in! The first step toward a proper currency / XP loop
[/list]

[h2]Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added blood spray VFX when players take damage from threats
[*] Added a blood splatter decal that is left behind when players die
[*] Adjustments and fixes to multiple doorways and door alignments
[*] Added destroyed versions for each malfunctioning screen hazard, so they now leave behind a broken version of the screens after exploding
[*] Fixed the explosion scorch decals from exploding screens that were sometimes spawning at an incorrect angle
[*] Increased explosive barrel’s explosion vfx size to better match the damage radius for explosive barrels
[*] Added more debris to exploding wall screen explosions to look better now that they leave a broken version left behind after exploding
[*] Added a new helmet interior mesh
[/list]

[h2]Stability & General Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now read the map that another player is holding – fixed 3rd person tool orientation so they are held properly from the 3rd person view
[*] Lowered volume and pitch a bit on player ‘pain’ sound fx
[*] Lowered volume and repetition speed of sprinting ‘tired breathing’ sound fx
[*] Fixed inaccurate mission complete text for crimson core mission
[*] Added an intro video (skippable with any key press) that loads at game launch with a narrated version of the Crimson Event backstory that is also readable from the Field Guide (still having some v-sync style issues with the video playback though, so you may experience some scrolling black bars or flickering during the video)
[*] Increased friction on thrown glow sticks so they don’t side as far along the ground
[/list]

notes.title: Update 4: August 5th - Unreal Engine Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Update 4: Aug 5, 2024[/h1]
In this major update, the biggest element is changing from Unreal Engine 5.3 to 5.4, which broke a few things but brings substantial performance improvements.

Starting with general update notes first:

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Flame Torch starting fuel increased from 120 to 225
[*] Fixed fuel counter to properly show ammo amount for Fire Extinguisher
[/list]
[h2]Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Crimson Drive Core & Crimson Core Dock 3d assets & visual updates to the Crimson Drive room
[*] Added more decals and signage to various assets
[*] Fixed buggy “goop splatter” decal from exploding eggs to no longer stretch way up the walls/doorway when eggs explode
[*] Various other small tweaks and improvements
[/list]

[h2]Stability & General Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The lobby has been temporarily disabled[/b], as the 5.4 engine update broke them. For now, host players will load directly into the POD and will see a message prompting them to wait for all other joining players before starting a mission
[*] As a result, players will be sent back to the main menu after ending a mission. We are currently working on a fix for this to bring lobbies back asap
[*] Added missing drop weapon (“Drop Current Tool”) button to key binding list in options
[/list]

[h1][u]Performance[/u][/h1]
Unreal has been updated from version 5.3 to 5.4, which should bring upwards of 1.5 - 1.8x performance improvements.

With that and the previous video setting tweaks from the last update, we now have some recommended settings changes based on desired performance/your hardware and everyone should be seeing better frame rates across almost all hardware levels.

[h2]Notes On Performance & Settings[/h2]
Screen resolution is the single greatest component to framerate in the game, as a large amount of Lumen costs revolve around it. By default, the game will run in “Windowed Full Screen” mode, which will use your existing desktop resolution.

A 4k screen vs a 1440p screen will literally have upwards of ½ the performance of the lower resolution screen setup. The best way to fix this is with the use of the “3D Resolution” video setting, which is a built in form of upscaling similar to DLSS.

[i]All performance metrics assume the player is Host (Client players will see higher performance than Host players). Numbers are collected by me personally from several playthroughs, so your mileage may vary.

So far testing has shown that performance improvements are even better for lower resolution screens and hardware ([b]eg - we had one tester on a GTX 1060 now hitting consistent 20-35fps on HIGH settings with 50% 3d Resolution, that was previously seeing 5-15fps on LOW settings![/b])[/i]

[h3]Max Visuals[/h3]
All Settings on Epic, 100% 3d Resolution.
This will give you the maximum visual quality, at the lowest framerates. 

Expect approximately 20-35fps (~30 median) on an RTX 3080ti GPU @ 4k Resolution.

[h3]High Visual Quality[/h3]
All settings on Epic, except for Reflections and Effects, set to “High.”
70% 3D Resolution.

Expect approximately 33-48 (~42 median) FPS on an RTX 3080ti GPU @ 4k Resolution.

[h3]Balanced Visuals & Performance[/h3]
All settings on Epic, except for Reflections and Effects, set to “High.”
50% 3D Resolution.

Expect approximately 40-55 FPS (~48 median) on an RTX 3080ti GPU @ 4k Resolution.

[h3]Performance Priority[/h3]
All settings on Medium.
70% 3D Resolution.

Expect approximately 45-62 FPS (~53 median) on an RTX 3080ti GPU @ 4k Resolution.

[h3]Maximum Performance[/h3]
All settings on Low. (NOTE: This will disable Lumen lighting ENTIRELY, resulting in a significantly darker visual appearance)
50% 3D Resolution.

Expect approximately 62-80 FPS (~75 median) on an RTX 3080ti GPU @ 4k Resolution.

[h1]Upcoming[/h1]
Upcoming changes will need to continue to focus on some stability and and functionality improvements as we continue to rebuild from a few of the things that Unreal 5.4 broke, as well as continue to improve the overall functionality of the game. After that, then we can get back to the fun stuff -- improving the gameplay!

The next upcoming targets include"
[list]
[*] Getting lobbies back online for a better join/start mission experience
[*] Eliminating more bugs from level generation that occasionally lead to failed hallway generation at level load
[*] Private vs Public server options
[/list]

notes.title: July 23rd: First Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: First Update![/h1]
July 23rd, 2024.

The first update is here! It's been wild ride in the last 36 hours since launch day with a lot of great feedback to pour over, bugs to fix, and improvements to keep building on.

Up first is a set of minor tweaks and bug fixes, with more substantial improvements to come after that.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
-Reduced Tankiness of some threats
-Larger boom-boom radius on explosive tanks
-Reduced damage on electrical-explosive wall screens

[h2]Art[/h2]
-New textures for explosive fuel tanks!
-A few general fixes and improvements
-Scanner’s ‘mode’ text is now larger and easier to read when changing between different scan modes
-Fixed redundant screen in the Field Guide

[h2]Stability & General Bugs[/h2]
-Removed “key bindings to nowhere” for functions that are no longer in the game
-Removed HP value for POD mission console that allowed it to be destroyed

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
Some immediate goals that will be coming next are stability and performance focused before getting back to gameplay and balancing.

The main ones will include:
-Ensuring servers with a mission already in progress can not be joined (fixes “just space” outside of the airlock bug)
-Support for private servers vs being all public
-This one may take a little longer, but we should also see some rather large performance improvements once we can upgrade from Unreal 5.3 to 5.4!
